rooms.description: A low arc of navigation and radar consoles sits in silhouette beneath a broad band of blue-grey windows streaked with spray. A weather display anchors one end, a clipped radio and log station the other.
rooms.feeling: Exposed to the gale, with every instrument close at hand.

rooms.description: From just above the gritty anti-slip deck, teal water lines loop under steel benches into squat pumps. Rows of capped sample bottles catch hard ceiling glare, and condensation beads along the tall sampling rack.
rooms.feeling: Humid and loud, with a steady tremor underfoot.

rooms.description: At chair height, a four-panel monitor wall forms a precise rectangle above a straight row of workstations. Muted violet traces shine onto matte desktops, with small pinned plots squared neatly beside the screens.
rooms.feeling: Hushed and cool enough to hear a keystroke.

rooms.description: From above, a bolted oval table fills the foreground, dotted with mismatched mugs and coffee rings. Soft yellow ceiling light reaches the galley counter, squat refrigerator and corkboard crowded with curling scraps.
rooms.feeling: Warm and familiar, with breakfast still half cleared.

rooms.description: From the doorway, a narrow exam bed projects into a broad patch of pale green flooring. Diffuse ceiling light softens the edges of flush, latched cabinets, a slim diagnostic cart and a bare report desk.
rooms.feeling: Still and clinical, with space to catch your breath.

rooms.description: Four pairs of narrow cabin doors recede toward a lit cross-passage. Its spill picks out the red kickplates in diminishing strokes and catches a pair of damp socks clipped to the nearest door handle.
rooms.feeling: Close and private, as if a raised voice would carry through every door.

rooms.description: Over the shoulder of a scuffed chair, an angled laptop cuts across a pair of monitors showing grey sea footage. Their glow grazes camera lenses, hooked headphones, a row of battery chargers and pinned shot grids.
rooms.feeling: Absorbed and slightly makeshift, with yesterday’s footage still open.

rooms.description: From a corner, tall parts racks rise around a workbench. An articulated work light pools over an orange vise and a test meter, with upright spanners, a maintenance terminal and clipped diagrams packed behind them.
rooms.feeling: Loud and practical, with a repair taking up the bench.

people.description: Broad shoulders taper sharply to a narrow waist in a charcoal blazer with a muted violet pocket square. He leans back, palm open, with a sideways glance, high cheekbones and neatly side-parted silver hair under crisp light.
people.feeling: Courteous and persuasive, with impatience held in check.

people.description: Tall and straight through the hips, she clasps both hands behind her blue bridge jacket. Pale rim light traces her close-cropped curls and upright collar, while a long nose and level, direct gaze hold the center.

Seated narrow-shouldered above a fleece bunched wide at her hips, she holds a teal sample notebook against one knee. Soft daylight catches wisps escaping a low bun as she lifts tired eyes beneath gently arched brows.
people.feeling: Warm and observant, with fatigue showing in the pause before she answers.

people.description: Stocky and square across the chest, he hunches over his knuckles, wiping them with an orange rag. A pool of light picks out grease on his coverall cuffs, flattened black hair and a heavy, stubbled jaw.
people.feeling: Bone-tired and intent on the work in his hands.

people.description: Slight in profile, she curves one shoulder toward her folded hands at the base of the frame. Soft light washes over her loose sage scrubs, freckles and blunt bob as she watches just past the viewer.
people.feeling: Quietly attentive, comfortable leaving a pause open.

people.description: Lanky in a fitted red zip jacket, he pitches forward across the frame with one crooked finger against his cheek. Screen glow picks up unruly blond waves and one raised eyebrow as he looks off-frame.
people.feeling: Restless curiosity, always on the verge of another question.
